description.value: Little River Regional Nature Park is a nature reserve managed by the Comox Valley Regional District, situated in the Comox Valley on Vancouver Island. It forms part of the regional parks and trails network, offering natural green space in proximity to Courtenay and Comox. Touring cyclists passing through the Comox Valley may find it a worthwhile scenic detour along regional routes.
